pk.context: 15 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Its active metabolite, dehydro-aripiprazole, reaches about 40% of parent exposure and has a half-life of about 94 hours.

clues.text: About 87% of an oral tablet dose reaches the circulation, and it can be taken with or without food. More than 99% is bound to serum proteins, and it is cleared mainly by hepatic metabolism via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4.
A dihydrocarbostyril with a dichlorophenyl piperazine side chain and a molecular weight of 448.38.
Approved under an NDA as tablets of 2, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30 mg.

Boxed warning for higher mortality in elderly patients with dementia and for suicidal thoughts in young patients. Contraindicated after hypersensitivity; nausea, vomiting and constipation are most common.
Schizophrenia; acute manic or mixed episodes of bipolar I disorder; adjunctive major depression; irascibility associated with autistic disorder; and Tourette's disorder.
Partial agonist activity at D2 and 5-HT1A receptors, with antagonist activity at 5-HT2A receptors.
The generic name begins with A and has twelve letters.
